reviews.text:
This lip tint has a lightweight, comfortable formula that feels nice on the lips. The pigmentation isn’t extremely intense, which I actually prefer because it lets me build up the color gradually instead of getting a bold look right away. It gives a more natural, customizable finish.

The tint is long-lasting, doesn’t dry out my lips, and wears evenly throughout the day. Another nice bonus is the mini version of a different shade included with it. It’s a great way to try another color before purchasing the full size. Overall, I’m very happy with this product and would recommend it.
reviews.zh:
呢支唇釉質地輕盈舒服，搽喺唇上感覺好好。顯色度唔算好強，但我反而鍾意咁樣，因為可以一層一層慢慢疊上去，而唔係一落嚟就已經好搶眼。做出嚟嘅妝效自然又可以自己調教。

唇釉夠持久，唔會令到我嘴唇乾，全日都 keep 得均勻。另一個加分位係跟咗另一隻色號嘅細裝。可以先試吓另一隻色再買正裝。整體嚟講我對呢個產品好滿意，會推薦。

reviews.shade: [SET] 02 Sweet Rose Apple (+Sugar Topping Jelly Gloss #Starry White)
reviews.text: What an amazing tint! Super glossy, gorgeous color and the color doesn’t keep getting darker if you reply throughout the day.
reviews.zh: 呢支唇釉真係超正！超光澤，隻色好靚，而且成日補妝都唔會越嚟越深。

reviews.shade: [SET] 09 Indifferent Fig (+Sugar Topping Jelly Gloss #Starry Pink)
reviews.text: I like this lip tint. the formula is great and it feels very moisturizing and it's not sticky at all. The color payoff is great.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢支唇釉。質地好好，超保濕，完全唔黐。顯色度好高。

reviews.text:
つやつやすぎてこれ一本でいける。
ピンクが少し入ったプラムで上品な色味。
ペリペラのキャンパスクイーンと似てるかなって思ったけど、こっちの方が鮮やかでピンクが強いかな！
これは大人っぽくなりたい子は買いだよ！
reviews.zh:
光澤感強到一支就搞掂。
係帶少少粉紅嘅梅子色，色調好優雅。
本來以為會好似 Peripera 嘅 Campus Queen，但呢支鮮明啲，粉紅感重啲！
想變得成熟感嘅女仔一定要買！

reviews.shade: [SET] 09 Indifferent Fig (+Sugar Topping Jelly Gloss #Starry Pink)
reviews.text: Super cute! The formula is great, the pigment is perfect, the texture is smooth, and the color is so dreamy
reviews.zh: 超可愛！質地好好，顯色度一流，質感順滑，隻色夢幻到爆

reviews.shade: [SET] 02 Sweet Rose Apple (+Sugar Topping Jelly Gloss #Starry White)
reviews.text: 使用感は良かったです。引き続き使い続けようと思います！！
reviews.zh: 使用感覺好好。會繼續用落去！！

reviews.shade: [SET] 02 Sweet Rose Apple (+Sugar Topping Jelly Gloss #Starry White)
reviews.text: 02番のカラーは見た目はブラウン系ですが、実際につけると少しピンクっぽいです。膜感はなく、少しだけ染唇します。おまけのミニリップティントはラメが大きすぎて、唇に貼り付いているような感じがしました。
reviews.zh: 02 嗰隻色睇落係啡色系，但實際搽上嘴偏少少粉紅。冇膜感，只係輕微染唇。附送嘅細裝唇釉個閃粉太大粒，貼喺唇上面嘅感覺好怪。

reviews.shade: [SET] 02 Sweet Rose Apple (+Sugar Topping Jelly Gloss #Starry White)
reviews.text:
I love this lip tint soo much. the formula is great. feels very moisture but not sticky at all. color payoff is great
the color is really pretty but it's really not the same as shown in the picture. I got 02 sweet rose apple and it's actually like a muted summer than a warm color as the brand describe. it's a lot more purpleish so i deduct 1 star
reviews.zh:
我超鍾意呢支唇釉。質地好好，好保濕但完全唔黐。顯色度好高
隻色好靚但同相入面睇到嘅真係差好遠。我買咗 02 sweet rose apple，但其實係偏 muted summer 多過品牌講嘅暖色。偏紫好多，所以扣咗一星

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
